system.description:
Your hail of fire can catch secondary targets in your firing arc.

Prerequisites: Rapid Shot, Base Attack Bonus +6

Effect: When you deal damage with a single, non-Area Attack using the Rapid Shot Feat, once per turn on your turn, you can immediately make a second attack at a -2 penalty against a second target within 2 squares of the first. If this attack hits, you deal half the original attack's damage to that target.

prerequisite.text: Rapid Shot feat, and Base Attack Bonus 6
